title: Letter: the US EPA says power plants providing electricity only to data centers and not to the public grid would not be subject to federal pollution laws (Tim McLaughlin/Reuters)
summary: Tim McLaughlin / Reuters: Letter: the US EPA says power plants providing electricity only to data centers and not to the public grid would not be subject to federal pollution laws — Power sources providing electricity only to data centers and not the public grid may not be subject to federal pollution laws …
